main_text.p: omini, Matth.12. 29. Luc. 11.21. Balenæ, Esaiæ 27. 1. Leoni rugienti, 1. Petr.5.8. vt fulgur è cœlo cadit, Luc. 10. 18. vocatur Draco magnus, & Serpens antiquus, Apocal. 12. 9. generis humani hostis est, Genes.3.1. Matth. 13.39. 1. Petr.5. imperium mortis habere dicitur, Hebr.2.14. quia ab ipso exortum est peccatum, quod mors est consecuta, & ipse nos quotidie ad peccandum solicitat, vt nos in æternæ mortis exitium secum trahat. Iudam ingreditur, Luc.22. 3. Ioann. 13. 27. in malis efficaciter operatur, Ephes.2.2.2. Thess.2.9. Tentator est, Marc. 1.13. Luc.4.2. Actor.5.3. 1. Cor. 7.5.1. Thess.3.5. Matt.4.3.

Diabolus cum suis angelis in terram deiectus, Apocal.12. 9. deo subiectus, 1. Sam.16.14. & 18.10. 1. Reg.22, ver.20.23. Iob.1.v.6.7.12 & 2.v.1. 6. Matth. 8. v.31.32. Marc.5. v.12.13. Luc.8. v.31.32. & 22.31.2. Thess. 2. v. 9. 11. non plus potest, quàm Deus illi permittat, 1. Regum 22. 22. 2. Paral. 18.20. Iob.1.12. & 2.6. Matth.8.31. Marc.5.12. Ephes.2.2.2. Timoth, 1.26. Apoc.20, 7. tribuntur illi potestatum ac principum appellatio, Eph.6.12. ab effectu Diabolorum, ex quibus intelligitur, quæ sit illorum vis ac potestas, minimè id quidem quasi vel sit infinita illorum potentia, vel quod possunt suapte vi possint, vel quod ita illis laxet habenas Deus, vt eorum audacia ad amplificandam suam gloriam vtatur. Diabolus superatur à Christo, Matth. 12. 29. Luc. 11. 22. Coloss.2.15. Hebr.2.14.1. Ioann.3.8. à Deo, Roman.16.20. a fidelibus, Iacob.4.7.1. Petr.5.9.1. Ioann.2. v.13.14. transformatur in Angelum lucis, 2. Corinth. 11.14. colaphis cædit Paulum, 2 Cor.12.7

DIABOLI, siue Satanæ Angelus, pro ipso Satana, 2. Corinth. 2.7. astutia eius, Genes.3.v.4.5.1. Paralip.21.1. Iob.1.11.& 2. 4. Matth.4.3.& 13.19. Marc.4.15. Luc.8.12. Act.16.17.2.
